mutation_evidence.description: Search params reverted to { q: string; limit?: number; offset?: number }
mutation_evidence.change: search: (params: { q: string; cursor?: string; page_size?: number }) → search: (params: { q: string; limit?: number; offset?: number })
mutation_evidence.nature_of_mutation: TypeScript type-signature-only change. TypeScript types are erased at runtime — params as Record<string, unknown> serializes whatever keys are passed regardless of the declared interface. Runtime Vitest tests cannot distinguish between the two signatures when called with only q (TC-ISS0820-01) or page_size (TC-ISS0820-02) etc.
